record.destination: Wayfinder-style planning works at three altitudes with granularity to match: (1) roadmap shaping — 5k ft, create/edit/move roadmap nodes like a mind map without going deep; (2) ideation — 10k ft, 'wouldn't it be cool if' PO/CEO-level brainstorm of new features; (3) feature definition — PRD-level, how a feature works and its sub-features. Each altitude gets the partner posture: grills the human for decisions only they can make, runs research/prototype tickets AFK and returns with findings, makes delegated judgment calls, and hands off to build the moment the human says 'enough to start' — no full de-fogging required.
out_of_scope: Shape 2 launcher ('nahel plan' spawning an agent CLI from bare bash) — deferred to later-horizon node plan-launcher (8qtfdcxz); this feature is agent-starts-nahel only

Rich ideation / proactive recommendation engine (partner generating ideas, market scanning, fuller trade-off briefs under human governance) — deferred to later-horizon node recommendation-engine (t96cbcnh)
PM-tool adapters (GitHub Issues, Linear, Trello, Jira) — separate roadmap concern, already recorded (c31rnb9k); planning stays fully in-store this round

payload.body: Phase 4 already shipped the substrate: maps, 4 ticket types (research/prototype/grilling/task), advisory blocking, frontier, derived decisions, chart-map.md + work-map.md workflows. This feature builds the CONDUCTOR on top. Matt Pocock's wayfinder + grill-with-docs (github.com/mattpocock/skills; grilling lives under skills/productivity/, domain-modeling under skills/engineering/) are the reference; grill-with-docs is one line delegating to grilling + domain-modeling. Vendoring: pin via existing skills.yaml/lock machinery (F7/ADR-0009) with nested-category locator support. Ideation ships thin in v1; the rich version is deferred (recommendation-engine). Grilling tickets are HITL under human governance — the partner answers its own interview questions ONLY under a recorded DD6 delegation ('use your default recommendations', journaled and cited) or under delegated/agent governance; human-only tickets are never self-answered under any mode.
